name: std::basic_string_view<CharT,Traits>::substr

declarations.code:
constexpr basic_string_view substr(size_type pos = 0,

    size_type count = npos) const;

intro: Returns a view of the substring [pos, pos + rlen), where rlen is the smaller of count and size() - pos.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 position of the first character


 count

 -

 requested length

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: View of the substring [pos, pos + rlen).
